nodes.question: What has driven the proliferation of healthcare technologies according to the paragraph?
nodes.answer: Global concerns about an aging population, epidemics, pandemics, health inequalities, and escalating healthcare costs have driven the proliferation of healthcare technologies.
nodes.paragraph: The proliferation of healthcare technologies has been driven by global concerns about an aging population, epidemics, pan- demics, health inequalities, and escalating healthcare costs (Abernethy et al. 2022). These electronic healthcare devices (EHDs) are alternative solutions to conventional healthcare equipment, offering reliable diagnostics, self- monitoring capabilities, improved patient comfort, and less invasive procedures (Tian et al. 2019).
